rule:
Eligible = not a deep-audit direct competitor (the S8 knock-out). Top 30 = best 15 eligible per track by
round-2 Elo (a short track's gap is filled from the other), ordered by rubric band (S, A, B, then below 65), then Elo:
Elo ranks, the rubric bands. Below-65 ideas are ranked only to reach ~30 and carry below_bar: true
(deviation from PROMPT S11 "drop below 65", logged 2026-09-26: only 11 of 60 finalists cleared 65); 64-65 is
labelled borderline. Gate D drops ({id: rationale}) leave the ranking and the next eligible idea of the same track fills in.

gate_d_drops.I-1019: Strict subset of its own child I-5101 (rank 9, parents [I-1019, I-2067]): same on-device statement scan for new payees and duplicate charges, same buyer, same T8 dossier. Lowest rubric of the trio (61.7), and StatementLock already parses statements in-browser, the closest thing to a direct match. Keeping parent and child pads the list.
gate_d_drops.I-2514: Identical mechanism to I-3093 (rank 7): gpt-oss-20b on one workstation checking briefs against a locally cached case-law index. Only the payer differs (E&O broker vs attorney), and the red team rates that go-to-market unproven. Rubric 57.8, lowest of the three cite-checkers in the set. Fold the broker channel into I-3093's business-model line.

deep_prior_art.note: Live self-report distrust verifiers exist but none confirmed as a second independent agent re-navigating the live portal/target for claims-ops fleets with a signed per-verification fee.

red_team.objection: Second-agent completion verification already exists in three live forms (AEVS, agent-completion-verifier, AgentLiar); niche/billing differentiation is thin and a primary-agent vendor could add first-party verification.
red_team.fix: Sell as a neutral, cross-vendor auditor to payers/insurers who need independence from the agent operator.

finalists.name: Private Elder Statement Scanner

deep_prior_art.note: Elder-fraud monitoring exists via cloud account-linking (Carefull, EverSafe); StatementLock parses statements in-browser but isn't elder-specific or fully on-device.

red_team.objection: StatementLock already parses uploaded statements in-browser for fraud/duplicates; Carefull/EverSafe own the funded elder-fraud niche via easier cloud account-linking.
red_team.fix: Lead with the offline/no-SSN-in-cloud trust angle StatementLock and Carefull can't match; target families who refuse account-linking.

finalists.gate_d_drop: Strict subset of its own child I-5101 (rank 9, parents [I-1019, I-2067]): same on-device statement scan for new payees and duplicate charges, same buyer, same T8 dossier. Lowest rubric of the trio (61.7), and StatementLock already parses statements in-browser, the closest thing to a direct match. Keeping parent and child pads the list.

deep_prior_art.note: Both help with Medicaid enrollment/renewal but neither audits a filled packet against rejection-trigger rules before submission.

red_team.objection: HeyMedicaid and Fortuna Health own this niche and could add a rejection-rule check quickly; buyer files rarely, weakening repeat revenue.
red_team.fix: Position as an audit layer these incumbents integrate, not a standalone competing app.

deep_prior_art.note: Yoodli already nudges live during real video calls with replay analytics; Poised does live in-call coaching too. Same mechanism and niche.

red_team.objection: Yoodli already nudges pace/fillers/energy live during real video calls plus replay analytics, the exact mechanism in the same B2C interview niche; Poised does live in-call coaching too.
red_team.fix: Narrow to a sub-niche Yoodli ignores (non-native-speaker phrasing, bootcamp white-label) instead of general live nudges.

deep_prior_art.note: Open-source 'System 1 reflex layer' implementations already sit directly on/beside Jev, judging every event with a fast model and escalating to a slower one.

red_team.objection: Open-source reflex layers (Reflex-S1, System1-mcp) already implement exactly this mechanism on Jev, and the idea depends on Jev's own unverified speed/cost claims.
red_team.fix: Pick one concrete downstream product and verify Jev's real latency/cost before building a platform.

deep_prior_art.note: TMS tools auto-generate rate cons from structured load data, but none teach themselves a lane/carrier's format from one hand-built example as this idea proposes.

red_team.objection: Tai TMS, ARK TMS and FastFreight already auto-generate rate confirmations from structured load data with no learning step; switching cost from an existing TMS is real and one-shot learning is unproven across rate variance.
red_team.fix: Target brokers without a TMS, not TMS-equipped shops that already automate this.

finalists.name: Screen API for Legacy PM Systems

deep_prior_art.note: Funded companies already turn legacy PM/EHR screens into agent-callable automation for billing/RCM using computer-use workers; metered endpoint is a business-model variant, not a new mechanism.

red_team.objection: Beacon Health, Clicks Health and AKASA already ship funded computer-use agents automating legacy PM/EHR screens for RCM; metered pricing isn't a moat.
red_team.fix: Narrow to specific PM systems these funded players haven't wrapped, or supply tools under their platforms.

finalists.name: Stop the Wire Before It Sends

deep_prior_art.note: Enterprise AP bank-detail-change screening is mature; SMB no-finance-team niche unclaimed.

red_team.objection: Bank-detail-change screening before payment is a mature funded category (Eftsure, Trustpair, Stampli); the SMB gap is a pricing tier any of them can ship faster than a new entrant can build trust.
red_team.fix: Launch as a cheap SMB tier bundled inside QuickBooks/Xero rather than standalone.

deep_prior_art.note: Questionnaire auto-answer tools exist but use API integrations for security teams, not a browser agent logging in as the SMB owner.

red_team.objection: Questionnaire-automation tools already exist for security teams; letting an agent auto-log into a client's live admin console and answer insurance questions creates real liability if it misreads a control.
red_team.fix: Keep the owner as final signer on every answer and cap liability for misread controls contractually.

deep_prior_art.note: Live tools already read a real codebase and turn an incoming ticket/request into a grounded effort/impact estimate; client-feature-request framing is a thin wrapper on an existing mechanism.

red_team.objection: Bito AI Architect, a Jira Ticket Estimator skill, and open-source agent-estimate already read a real codebase and turn a ticket into a grounded estimate; the client-feature-request framing is a thin wrapper on an existing mechanism.
red_team.fix: None credible without a genuinely different mechanism or niche these tools structurally can't reach.

competitors: CallSphere AI voice agents for prior authorization (https://callsphere.ai/blog/ai-voice-agents-prior-authorization-payer-phone-automation)
deep_prior_art.note: Crowded prior-auth AI space, but none found do live, quote-cited real-time transcription of the P2P call itself into a structured appeal file the moment it ends.

red_team.objection: Prior-auth AI space is crowded (BastionGPT, CallSphere, Prosper); live-recording a payer's rep also risks two-party consent law exposure the card never addresses.
red_team.fix: Add explicit per-state call-recording consent capture; lead on the quote-cited real-time differentiator.

deep_prior_art.note: Filler removers cover sync/filler cleanup; ElevenLabs Voice Changer transfers expressive delivery but needs a performed reference take, not auto monotone-to-lively conversion.

red_team.objection: Filler removal and expressive speech-to-speech each cover half the pitch separately; the unclaimed auto-expressiveness transform is an unverified capability claim.
red_team.fix: Validate the auto-expressiveness transform on real audio first; fall back to filler-removal-plus-sync if weak.

deep_prior_art.note: Local/offline legal LLM setups exist, but none packaged as case-folder-to-motion-draft matching firm templates, zero-network, at solo-lawyer pricing.

red_team.objection: Local/offline legal LLM tools already solve privacy-and-offline; remaining differentiation is a closable feature gap, and unchecked drafting risks malpractice-grade hallucination.
red_team.fix: Ship a mandatory citation/fact-check pass before any draft is shown; lead on template-matching.

deep_prior_art.note: Smart Moving already sells a rotate/tilt stairwell-and-doorway clearance solver to moving companies, same niche and mechanism.

red_team.objection: Smart Moving: Furniture Helper already ships camera-based measuring plus rotation/tilt clearance solving through stairs and doorways to moving companies, same niche and mechanism.
red_team.fix: Differentiate on checkout-embedded scan-at-purchase workflow or undercut on price; otherwise hard to justify.

finalists.name: Client Quote Estimator for Dev Shops

deep_prior_art.note: Devtimate quotes from uploaded briefs not a real repo scan; the repo-scanning tools target internal estimation, not client billing quotes.

red_team.objection: Devtimate already sells client-ready quotes to agencies; the repo-scan grounding edge is flagged [unverified], and a wrong AI quote creates client-facing liability.
red_team.fix: Ship estimates as ranges with confidence flags and a mandatory human-review gate before clients see them.

deep_prior_art.note: Cut-based filler removers are common but none re-synthesize full audio in the same voice with an energy lift while forced-aligning timestamps for slide sync.

red_team.objection: Same idea as I-1555; incumbents (Descript, Cleanvoice, OpusClip) already do cut-based filler removal and slide sync, leaving only an unbuilt, unverified re-synthesis feature as differentiation.
red_team.fix: Ship as an add-on inside an existing lecture-capture platform (Panopto, Echo360) instead of standalone.

deep_prior_art.note: AI-slop bounty triage pain and reputation gating are already live, but no product uses a refundable per-submission x402 stake with automated-reproduction forfeiture.

red_team.objection: HackerOne/Bugcrowd already gate fake reports via free reputation scoring; a cash bond on top is extra friction incumbents have no reason to add.
red_team.fix: Launch on new/small bounty programs with no existing reputation history, not as an add-on to HackerOne.

deep_prior_art.note: General hallucination-highlighters and carrier-side claims automation exist, but none pairs a full claim file with a carrier's AI summary for independent adjuster sign-off review.

red_team.objection: General hallucination-highlighters (GPTZero, Originality.ai) already do sentence-level claim checking, and carrier-side claims-AI vendors already build audit trails; the independent-adjuster niche may be too small to justify a dedicated product.
red_team.fix: Ship as a thin claims-specific wrapper around an existing hallucination-detection API rather than building detection from scratch.

deep_prior_art.note: Offline/local AI scribes for therapists exist and address privacy; none package the specific per-claim timestamp-citation-and-flag UI, which differentiates the mechanism.

red_team.objection: Local therapist scribes already exist, including a free open-source option; the only edge (timestamp citation UI) is thin against free alternatives once copied.
red_team.fix: Ship the citation/flagging UI first and make it the headline demo differentiator.

deep_prior_art.note: Real-time senior scam-call detection exists but none confirmed to target AI voice-clone family-emergency calls with proxy alerts.

red_team.objection: ShieldsOn and Android's built-in OS-level fake-call detection already flag scam calls for seniors, one free and platform-owned, a structural threat no pricing fixes.
red_team.fix: Focus narrowly on the proxy-alert-to-adult-child feature Android/ShieldsOn lack and market that specifically.

competitors: Ropes & Gray AI Court Order Tracker
deep_prior_art.note: Standing-order trackers and citation checkers exist separately; no combined per-filing video briefing found.

red_team.objection: Standing-order trackers and citation checkers already exist separately; a video wrapper is a thin, easily-copied UX layer over two live capabilities.
red_team.fix: Validate litigators prefer video over a one-line checklist before building the video pipeline.

finalists.name: E&O Broker's Citation Shield

deep_prior_art.note: Citation-hallucination checking is a crowded live category, but none found are distributed by malpractice-insurance brokers, run on-prem, or surface only an aggregate risk score to underwriting.

red_team.objection: Citation-checking is dominated by Clearbrief (~70% of Am Law 20); the real novelty is broker distribution, which assumes brokers act as software distributors -- an unproven go-to-market, not a proven product gap.
red_team.fix: Validate broker interest with one design partner before building on-prem infra.

finalists.gate_d_drop: Identical mechanism to I-3093 (rank 7): gpt-oss-20b on one workstation checking briefs against a locally cached case-law index. Only the payer differs (E&O broker vs attorney), and the red team rates that go-to-market unproven. Rubric 57.8, lowest of the three cite-checkers in the set. Fold the broker channel into I-3093's business-model line.

deep_prior_art.note: WISP templates and generic compliance-form agents exist, but none combine an AI-drafted WISP interview with a browser agent that auto-files the PTIN portal and insurer attestations.

red_team.objection: Autonomous filing on IRS PTIN and insurer portals risks costly mis-filings for compliance-focused buyers, a serious trust barrier not addressed by the card.
red_team.fix: Ship draft-and-review only for v1; add autonomous submission later as opt-in.

deep_prior_art.note: Krasyn's live, free Note Check tool already flags scribe-note sentences unsupported by the transcript across many vendors; same mechanism and adjacent niche.

red_team.objection: Krasyn's Note Check is live, free, and does the identical sentence-vs-transcript flagging across major scribe vendors, undercutting the $15/mo add-on regardless of local-only framing.
red_team.fix: Lead entirely with the local/no-cloud-upload guarantee Krasyn lacks as the sole reason to pay.

competitors: Windows 11 agentic Fix it button, Microsoft (https://www.pcworld.com/article/2773838/an-ai-driven-fix-it-button-is-just-what-windows-needs.html)
deep_prior_art.note: Microsoft is shipping an in-OS agentic Fix it button for Windows 11 Copilot+ PCs matching niche and mechanism closely, though free and bundled rather than paid third-party.

red_team.objection: Microsoft ships a free, in-OS, agentic Fix it button on Windows 11 Copilot+ PCs matching the exact niche and mechanism, bundled at zero cost.
red_team.fix: Target non-Copilot+/older Windows PCs, or pivot to the family remote-approval angle Microsoft lacks.

deep_prior_art.note: Carefull aggregates financial accounts via linking; Oma Care agentically calls government by phone. No product found that browser-agent-proxies across banks plus Medicaid/Medicare portals.

red_team.objection: Banks and Medicare/Medicaid portals actively detect and block automated logins (bot detection, MFA); storing a parent's live credentials for automated crawling is a major security/liability risk, and Carefull already owns the niche via safer API linking.
red_team.fix: Use official APIs/aggregation where available; reserve browser-agent login for portals with no API, with human MFA handoff.

deep_prior_art.note: Virtual mailboxes OCR-scan mail but require redirecting to their facility and don't extract Medicaid renewal deadlines or pre-fill responses.

red_team.objection: Premise requires the parent (not the tech-savvy adult child) to photograph their own mail, undermining onboarding for the least app-savvy population.
red_team.fix: Partner with mail-forwarding services so mail reaches the child's scanner automatically.

deep_prior_art.note: Fortuna Health matches the consumer Medicaid niche; Skyvern matches the portal-filing-agent mechanism; no product combines OCR-notice capture with autonomous reinstatement filing at signup.

red_team.objection: Fortuna Health already serves the consumer Medicaid-procedural niche and Skyvern already files no-API state forms; the idea recombines two live products' mechanisms for a narrow addressable moment.
red_team.fix: Partner into Fortuna Health's funnel rather than compete for the same discovery moment.

deep_prior_art.note: RedactLocal already ships local strip-then-reinsert redaction for lawyers/CPAs sending drafts to cloud AI, same niche and mechanism.

red_team.objection: RedactLocal already ships the exact strip-locally-then-reinsert redaction loop for the same lawyer/CPA buyer, live today.
red_team.fix: Find a concrete gap RedactLocal lacks (e.g., tax-specific field types, IRC §7216 logging) or abandon.

deep_prior_art.note: Form/e-signature and one-way announcement consent tools exist; no live multilingual interactive voice-dialogue agent logging a verbal yes was found.

red_team.objection: Using an AI agent to obtain 'informed consent' for AI recording is circular, and it's unclear ethics boards accept AI-agent-captured consent as sufficient; therapist liability if the AI mishandles the exchange is unresolved.
red_team.fix: Position as consent-capture assistance under ethics-board-reviewed scripts, not the compliance authority itself; keep a human confirmation step.

deep_prior_art.note: Mature paddle-raise capture category, but incumbents rely on human spotters entering data manually; no live product auto-detects paddles via camera+speech fusion.

red_team.objection: Mature entrenched incumbents (OneCause, GiveSmart, GalaBid) own paddle capture with CRM/payment lock-in; fusion tech claim is [unverified], and idea duplicates I-4519 in this same batch.
red_team.fix: Sell as an add-on feeding existing platforms; validate ballroom-noise fusion accuracy before demoing.

deep_prior_art.note: Walk-GPS mapping and succession advisory exist separately; no narrated-extraction succession-mapping combo found.

red_team.objection: GPS farm mapping and succession advisory both exist as separate live products; the paying buyer (advisors/lenders per report) is unvalidated distribution with no evidence anyone currently pays for this.
red_team.fix: Get one succession advisor or ag lender to confirm they'd pay per report before building.

deep_prior_art.note: Evidence-then-approve diagnosis exists as single-user local apps; no unified remote-family-approval-plus-undo product found.

red_team.objection: Evidence-then-approve diagnosis already exists in single-user apps and remote control already exists separately; this is a modest integration, not a hard mechanism, and also collides with Microsoft's free Fix it agent.
red_team.fix: Lead with the remote-family-approval workflow specifically, the one unfilled gap.

deep_prior_art.note: TypeSafe's Jev (launched Sept 2026, $40M seed) already ships sub-second, cheap, typed per-event judgments with escalation via a developer SDK, usage-priced — same mechanism and buyer.

red_team.objection: TypeSafe AI's Jev, launched Sept 2026 with $40M seed, already ships sub-second, cheap, typed per-event judgments with escalation to the same developer buyer at usage-based pricing.
red_team.fix: None credible as a general platform; only a narrow vertical wrapper might carve out space Jev doesn't own.

deep_prior_art.note: Hold-waiting/IVR-navigation call agents are well established, but none are scoped to practice-management vendor support lines or re-verify the fix against real system state before closing.

red_team.objection: General hold-waiting agents (OsmO, Google Hold for Me, DoNotPay) already solve the core mechanic; niche framing is a thin, easily-copied differentiator.
red_team.fix: Lead entirely on the post-call system-state verification step, the actual gap incumbents lack.

deep_prior_art.note: Live cloud tools check citations in the same niche, but all cloud-hosted; none run fully on-device to preserve privilege.

red_team.objection: Cloud cite-checkers (LawDroid, BriefCatch, Clearbrief) already own the niche; an unbenchmarked local 20B model missing a fabricated citation is a sanctions-grade failure mode.
red_team.fix: Publish a false-negative benchmark against known fabricated-citation cases before claiming reliability.

competitors: Elastic Security Labs internal AI triage (https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/ai-vulnerability-triage-bug-bounty-hackerone)
deep_prior_art.note: AI reproduces reported exploits in a sandbox and returns pass/fail already, but no confirmed packaged air-gapped/on-prem-only product for regulated bounty programs.

red_team.objection: Sandbox-reproduce-and-verdict is already well established (Konvu, Elastic, CVE-Genie); the claimed on-prem-only differentiator is unconfirmed for the closest competitor and could be added by them.
red_team.fix: Confirm directly whether Konvu can/will offer on-prem deployment before investing.

deep_prior_art.note: Fabricated-citation catching is crowded but all use legal-database APIs, not a vision browser-use agent, and none blocks e-filing submission.

red_team.objection: Westlaw Quick Check, LawDroid CiteCheck AI and BriefCatch already catch fabricated citations via faster, more reliable database APIs than a vision-based browser-search agent, and locking e-filing submit requires integration across many incompatible court portals.
red_team.fix: Use database APIs (CourtListener) for verification; scope the e-filing submit-lock differentiator to one court system first.

deep_prior_art.note: Live product enforces hard session-wide spend cap across multiple x402 merchant calls with receipts, same mechanism as the idea.

red_team.objection: AgentPay is a live, actively-developed project whose agentpay-session feature already enforces the exact session-wide spend cap this idea proposes.
red_team.fix: Package AgentPay's capability as a no-code maker UI rather than rebuilding the session-cap mechanism.

deep_prior_art.note: GPS field-note apps and AR underground-utility viewers exist separately; none combine narrated oral history, confidence-tagged provenance, and AR playback for farm succession.

red_team.objection: GPS farm mapping and AR underground-utility overlay already exist separately, plus outdoor AR pin accuracy from phone GPS alone is typically only a few meters, undercutting the precise-location value claim.
red_team.fix: Drop AR for v1 and validate GPS accuracy before promising precise on-site pinpointing.

deep_prior_art.note: Anchor Browser already logs into locked portals like Availity via computer use and exposes reads/writes as MCP tools for any AI client.

red_team.objection: Anchor Browser already sells this exact mechanism today and explicitly names Availity-style payer portals as a target use case, the idea's own flagship demo.
red_team.fix: Narrow to a vertical Anchor/Browserbase haven't packaged, e.g. Dentrix/Yardi desktop apps sold per-connector.

deep_prior_art.note: Generic AI POA/form-fillers exist but none maintain a bank-certification-form library, flag notarization gaps, and draft statute-citing rebuttal letters.

red_team.objection: Generic AI form-fillers (DocFills, OCR-Software.com) already address this problem space; maintaining dozens of banks' changing certification forms is a high-upkeep content-ops burden, and drafting statute-based rebuttal letters risks unauthorized-practice-of-law exposure.
red_team.fix: Cap scope to the top 10-15 banks by proxy volume; route rebuttal letters through attorney-reviewed templates.

deep_prior_art.note: Manual fit calculators and separate 3D room scanners both exist; none combine automatic full-route video-based 3D reconstruction with a verdict and maneuvering animation at checkout.

red_team.objection: Core mechanism depends on an [unverified] claim that ordinary phone video yields accurate 3D reconstruction; an existing app already gives maneuvering guidance from simpler manual measurements.
red_team.fix: Validate single-video reconstruction accuracy against LiDAR ground truth before promising the checkout demo.

deep_prior_art.note: DMS continuity niche active but via backend backup/restore, not a computer-use agent mirroring screens.

red_team.objection: Vendor-side continuity products (Dominion VUE Net) already solve DMS outages via backend backup, and continuous automated agent login likely violates CDK/Reynolds terms of service, risking dealer account suspension.
red_team.fix: Secure written permission or an API partnership with the DMS vendor before selling continuous automated login.

deep_prior_art.note: Cloud scribes push notes only to browser-based EHRs; local GUI agent for legacy desktop EHRs not found.

red_team.objection: Cloud scribes already push notes into browser EHRs; legacy-desktop GUI-grounding accuracy is unproven, and a misplaced click into a clinical record is a safety/liability incident.
red_team.fix: Require clinician field-by-field confirmation before any write to the EHR, never auto-submit.

deep_prior_art.note: Agent action-receipt tools are a live category, but all found competitors serve enterprise/commerce-risk or engineering buyers, not consumer daily-money-managers filing redacted Medicaid/Medicare proof.

red_team.objection: This idea depends on proxy agents reliably logging into locked bank/Medicaid portals, a shaky foundation given MFA and bot detection; a self-generated screenshot receipt is also not independent proof of the action it claims to verify.
red_team.fix: Anchor each receipt to the portal's own confirmation number and disclose the self-capture limitation; pair only with a proven proxy-agent layer.

deep_prior_art.note: Incumbents own gala paddle-raise capture via manual/mobile-bidding entry; none found fuse room cameras with live auctioneer speech recognition for automatic vision-based logging.

red_team.objection: Same entrenched incumbent category as I-3045, near-duplicate pitch within this batch, and shares the same [unverified] fusion-accuracy dependency plus an underaddressed guest-consent question.
red_team.fix: Merge with I-3045 into one validated pitch before choosing platform-add-on vs. standalone framing.

deep_prior_art.note: Trustpair owns vendor bank-change verification live but via automated data checks, not an outbound phone call; matching hackathon prototype exists but isn't live.

red_team.objection: Trustpair already owns bank-detail-change verification via faster, cheaper instant data checks; an unsolicited AI-voice verification call also gives the vendor no way to trust it isn't itself a scam.
red_team.fix: Route the callback through a human AP staffer reading an AI-drafted script, not a fully autonomous voice agent.

deep_prior_art.note: AI appeal-letter drafting from a photographed denial is live and common, but none confirmed to autonomously file into the plan's portal and independently re-verify a filing ID; Aegis has that mechanism but for provider-side buyers.

red_team.objection: AI appeal-letter drafting is already live (Claimable, Counterforce) and Aegis already auto-files through payer portals for providers; applying unattended portal-filing to a stressed family's own account within 72 hours raises real stakes for a filing error.
red_team.fix: Keep the refund-if-no-portal guarantee and add a human-review checkpoint before final submission.

deep_prior_art.note: Multilingual multi-currency invoice OCR auto-posting to a ledger is an established live category; mechanism identical, buyer niche narrower.

red_team.objection: Veryfi, Dext and Tofu already do multilingual, multi-currency invoice OCR with one-tap ledger posting at established scale; the mechanism is identical and the freelance-translator niche is a positioning choice incumbents can retarget quickly.
red_team.fix: Only viable as a thin vertical skin (pricing/UX for solo freelancers) on top of an existing OCR API.

deep_prior_art.note: Bank monitors and call-scam detectors exist separately, but none link a flagged call to a same-day new payee into one combined alert.

red_team.objection: EverSafe/Carefull and Hiya already cover the two halves separately; the card never explains how a bank statement reaches the device on-device without a cloud bank-login, undercutting the privacy pitch.
red_team.fix: Specify a local statement-ingestion path (e.g., bank app PDF export) that preserves the on-device claim end to end.

deep_prior_art.note: Live medical interpreters with exportable bilingual transcripts already ship (Mabel AI, GoSpeech, Aida, Opalite Health); differentiation would need low-resource-language depth.

red_team.objection: Mabel AI, GoSpeech, Aida, and Opalite Health are all live products doing real-time voice-to-voice medical/public-sector interpretation with exportable bilingual transcripts, the exact mechanism and niche.
red_team.fix: Benchmark speech-to-speech quality on target low-resource languages against Mabel/GoSpeech; proceed only if it wins.

finalists.name: Scope Gate for Your Own Agent

deep_prior_art.note: Scoped mandate plus pre-action interception exists as dev-infra and payment protocols; no found product packages it as a consumer subscription app for personal agents.

red_team.objection: Scoped mandates plus pre-action interception already exist as dev-infra and payment protocols; this targets a barely-existing consumer 'personal agent' market that platform vendors will likely own natively.
red_team.fix: Target early power-user adopters now and differentiate on cross-agent, multi-vendor enforcement.

deep_prior_art.note: Keito matches the buyer/billing niche but only attributes cost, no live hard-cap; llm0/LiteLLM hard-cap via proxy but are generic dev infra, not matter-rebilling products.

red_team.objection: Keito already matches the exact buyer and billing niche (client/matter cost attribution for solo professionals) and lacks only a live hard-cap, a feature an incumbent with existing distribution can add faster than a new entrant can win the niche.
red_team.fix: Ship the hard-cap-plus-matter-rebilling combo fast, targeting solo professionals Keito underserves.

deep_prior_art.note: Zonos already offers listing-to-HTS classification, invoice generation and low-value-shipment brokerage filing for small e-commerce sellers post-de-minimis change; same niche and mechanism.

red_team.objection: Zonos already reads listings, predicts HTS codes, generates customs data and files low-value entries for the identical post-de-minimis micro-seller niche.
red_team.fix: Undercut on price for sellers Zonos/Easyship underserve, or front-end an existing broker API instead of rebuilding classification.

deep_prior_art.note: Human vishing sims and AI-agent red-teaming both exist separately; no combined weekly test-fix-retest vendor found.

red_team.objection: The idea bundles two already-mature separate categories (human vishing simulators, AI-agent red-teaming) with no evidence anyone wants both together, plus real consent/legal exposure from cloned-voice attacks on rank-and-file staff.
red_team.fix: Validate bundle demand with one buyer first, or resell existing vendors under one white-label contract instead of rebuilding.

deep_prior_art.note: Live coaching copilots and real-time scam/fraud alerts exist separately; no single tool combines both plus discreet supervisor escalation.

red_team.objection: Real-time playbook coaching and real-time fraud/scam alerts already exist as separate live products; combining them is a closable feature gap, and it leans on the same unverified Jev speed claim as I-1050.
red_team.fix: Lead with the discreet phrase-triggered escalation and prove it on a standard verified LLM, not only Jev.

deep_prior_art.note: Several shipping AAC apps already listen to the conversation partner and surface AI suggestions, but each generates/predicts new text rather than ranking only the user's own pre-saved, approved phrases.

red_team.objection: Vocable AAC already offers a personal phrase library with AI assist during conversation, and Spoken/AAC Talker already listen to the partner; for switch-scanning users, any latency or mis-ranking risks making communication slower than existing manual navigation.
red_team.fix: Differentiate hard on the composition-free rank-only constraint and validate response-time gains with real AAC users before wider build.

deep_prior_art.note: Mechanism has academic prior art (2008 Converser prototype, not live), but no shipping standalone companion app ranks an imported phrase bank from partner speech; commercial apps predict from the user's own typing.

red_team.objection: Core mechanism has 2008 academic prior art that never commercialized, suggesting a non-technical blocker (privacy/consent); card doesn't address partner-consent for always-listening near the AAC user.
red_team.fix: Investigate why Converser never shipped and design an explicit listening-consent toggle before building.

finalists.name: Live call-verification copilot for payment requests

deep_prior_art.note: Balto matches the live-transcript, private-prompt, escalation mechanism but as general compliance coaching; Pindrop/Rulebase serve same fraud niche via deepfake detection instead.

red_team.objection: Balto already delivers the identical live-transcript, private-prompt, escalation mechanism as general compliance coaching, an easy feature addition for an incumbent with existing distribution.
red_team.fix: Sell pre-built payment-verification rule packs as a Balto/Gryphon integration instead of a standalone platform.
